topic: Database field null handling and validation
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on data entry best practices, specifically regarding the `activity` String field. It was confirmed that if a null value is entered into this non-nullable field, it will not cause an immediate database crash. The system can accept either a blank string or a null value (if configured to be nullable). If no value is provided, entering a blank string is safe and recommended.
decisions: The `activity` String field accepts empty strings.
